about: Hand-written lock rules for the Docklands zone, read on 2026-10-04 from the operators' pages and written here as structured facts in our own words (no page text is copied). tools/fetch-river.mjs locks adds OSM positions, live Canal & River Trust notices (crt_match keywords) and an HTTP check of each source. Windows are hours either side of high (HW) or low (LW) water at the named place. Where two pages of one operator disagree, both are kept under conflicts.

locks.name: Limehouse Lock (Limehouse Basin ship lock, Thames entrance)
locks.links: Thames (Limehouse Reach) to Limehouse Basin, and on to the Regent's Canal and the Limehouse Cut
locks.status: in service, staffed only for booked moves
locks.booking: online, at least 2 working days ahead; telephone and e-mail bookings confirmed 08:00 to 15:30 Monday to Friday; re-book if more than 30 minutes late; lock keepers on VHF channel 80

sources.title: Locks to the River Thames (CRT; page 'Last Edited: 22 September 2026')

locks.notes: A CRT notice of August 2026, 'Changes to Limehouse Lock operating times' (reason: low water levels), is open-ended: see crt_notices.

locks.name: West India Dock Entrance Lock (Blackwall entrance to West India and Millwall Docks)
locks.links: Thames (Blackwall Reach) to Blackwall Basin, West India Docks and Millwall Docks

hours.note: bookings guaranteed in these hours as the tide allows; other times by arrangement

locks.booking: by e-mail, seven days ahead; full salvage or wreck-removal insurance required to enter West India Dock; West India and Millwall Docks harbour regulations apply

conflicts.claim: open one hour either side of high water at London Bridge (minus about 20 minutes), 08:30 to 15:30, booked in advance (no notice period stated); no charge only with a confirmed berth or booked visitor mooring

sources.title: Locks to the River Thames (CRT; 'Last Edited: 22 September 2026')

locks.name: Bow Locks (Bow Creek to the Lee Navigation and Limehouse Cut)
locks.links: tidal Bow Creek (River Lea) to the Lee Navigation, Three Mills and the Limehouse Cut
locks.booking: by e-mail to the CRT Harbour Master, seven days ahead
locks.notes: OSM has the lock gates (node/259200697 and neighbours at 51.523, -0.008) but no named lock way; the position is the first gate.

locks.name: South Dock Lock (Greenland Dock and South Dock Marina sea lock)
locks.links: Thames (Limehouse Reach, beside Greenland Pier) to South Dock Marina; Greenland Dock behind it
locks.status: in service in office hours when there is enough water
locks.booking: advised (booking and registration form); VHF channels 37 and 80, callsign 'South Dock Marina'; waiting berth on the inner side of Greenland Pier

sources.title: South Dock Marina: navigation on the Thames (Southwark Council)

locks.notes: Depth over the cill = predicted tide level (above chart datum) minus 2.85 m. Chart datum near London Bridge is 3.20 m below OD (registry/sources/pla/README.md), so the cill is near -0.35 m OD.

locks.name: Commercial Road Lock 12 (Regent's Canal)
locks.links: Limehouse Basin to the Regent's Canal
locks.status: boater-operated canal lock (no booking); see notices
locks.notes: CRT notices of August 2026 announce ongoing overnight closures (14:00 to 09:00) at Commercial Road, Salmon Lane and Mile End locks for low water levels.

locks.name: Blackwall Basin Entrance Lock (former entrance)
locks.status: no operating rules found; the CRT pages name only the West India Dock Entrance Lock as the tidal lock of West India Docks

sources.title: Locks to the River Thames (CRT): lists the tidal locks

locks.name: St Katharine Docks Lock
locks.links: Thames (Upper Pool) to St Katharine Docks
locks.status: rules not collected (the marina's pages were not read in this pass)

locks.name: King George V Lock (Royal Docks)
locks.operator: Royal Docks Waterways (Royal Docks Management Authority)
locks.links: Thames (Gallions Reach) to King George V Dock and the Royal Docks
locks.status: rules not collected; Royal Docks Waterways publishes booking forms and a port safety code (royaldockswaterways.com/booking-forms/)
